data.name: Query_getDataFromBankFacility
data.value:
Select Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID, Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityName as FacilityName, Set_BankFacility.StartDate,Set_BankFacility.EndDate, Set_BankFacility.BankName as BankBranchName, Set_BankFacility.AccountNo, Set_BankFacility.LimitName, Set_BankFacility.LoanType, Set_BankFacility.Markup, Set_BankFacility.GracePeriod, Set_BankFacility.Funded, Set_BankFacility.NonFunded, Set_BankFacilityDetail.FromDate as MarkUpFromDate, Set_BankFacilityDetail.ToDate as MarkUpToDate, Set_BankFacility.Amount as AmountLimit , Set_BankFacilityDetail.InterestRate, AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountNumber from Set_BankFacility
Inner JOin Set_BankFacilityDetail on Set_BankFacilityDetail.BankFacilityHeaderID = Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityID and Set_BankFacilityDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankFacility.CompanyID AND Set_BankFacilityDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankFacility.PeriodID AND Set_BankFacilityDetail.Status = 1
Inner join AR_SET_BankAccount on AR_SET_BankAccount.CompanyID= Set_BankFacility.CompanyID and AR_SET_BankAccount.PeriodID = Set_BankFacility.PeriodID and AR_SET_BankAccount.BankAccountID = Set_BankFacility.BankID and AR_SET_BankAccount.Status = 1
Where Set_BankFacility.Status = 1 AND Set_BankFacility.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND Set_BankFacility.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AND (Set_BankFacility.BankFacilityName = @BankFacilityName or @BankFacilityName is null) AND (Set_BankFacility.StartDate > @FromDate or @FromDate is null) --AND (Set_BankFacility.EndDate < @ToDate or @ToDate is null)

data.name: Query_getDataFromBankGurantee
data.value: Select Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID, Set_BankGuarantee.BankName, Set_BankGuarantee.AccountNo, Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate, Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate, Set_BankGuarantee.Amount , Set_BankGuarantee.Charges as BankCharges, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeDetailID, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerID, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BusinessPartnerName, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Amount as GuranteeAmount, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.FromDate, Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.ToDate from Set_BankGuarantee Inner Join Set_BankGuaranteeDetail on Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.BankGuaranteeHeaderID = Set_BankGuarantee.BankGuaranteeID AND Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.CompanyID = Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID AND Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.PeriodID = Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID AND Set_BankGuaranteeDetail.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 Where Set_BankGuarantee.Status = 1 And Set_BankGuarantee.CompanyID = @CompanyID And Set_BankGuarantee.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (Set_BankGuarantee.StartDate > @FromDate or @FromDate is null) And (Set_BankGuarantee.EndDate < @ToDate or @ToDate is null)

data.name: Query_getDataFromPledgeBag
data.value:
Select IMP_PledgeBags.DocumentNo , IMP_PledgeBags.DocumentDate as PledgeDate, IMP_PledgeBags.BankName as BankBranchName, IMP_PledgeBags.AccountNo, IMP_PledgeBags.PledgeBags,IMP_PledgeBags.MarketValuePerBag As MarketRate, IMP_PledgeBags.TotalMarketValue as MarketPledgeAmount, IMP_PledgeBags.TotalMarketValueByBank As BankPledgeAmount , IMP_UnPledgeBags.DocumentNo as DePledgeBagDocNo,IMP_UnPledgeBags .DocumentDate as DepledgeDate, isnull(IMP_UnPledgeBags.UnPledgeBags,0) as DePledgeBags,IMP_UnPledgeBags.TotalMarketValue as DePledgeBagAmount
from IMP_PledgeBags
Left Join IMP_UnPledgeBags On IMP_UnPledgeBags.PledgeBagsId = IMP_PledgeBags.PledgeBagsID AND IMP_UnPledgeBags.CompanyID = IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID AND IMP_UnPledgeBags.PeriodID = IMP_PledgeBags.PeriodID AND IMP_UnPledgeBags.Status = 1
Where IMP_PledgeBags.Status = 1 AND IMP_PledgeBags.CompanyID = 1 AND IMP_PledgeBags.PeriodID = 1 AND IMP_PledgeBags.DocumentDate Between @FromDate And @ToDate AND (IMP_PledgeBags.DocumentNo = @PBNO Or @PBNO is Null)
